answer: Deposits are visible in lagoon, and ledge reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 124 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nebula account. A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 7 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
